concept.title: Home care and carer support
concept.shortdesc: Support for carers and practical, personal and social care or visits for people who need help to live independently at home.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Information, advice, assessments and support for people who care for family or friends, along with some information on advocacy and legal safeguards.
: Services that give carers a break from caring, through respite care, breaks or day centres for the person cared for.
: Regular company, social visits or sitting services for someone who is isolated or needs a reassuring presence, usually at home.
: Help with personal hygiene and grooming such as bathing, showering, dressing, foot care, or use of shower facilities.
: Practical help around the home such as light cleaning, chores, errands, simple cooking and general handyman jobs.
: Support, skills teaching and information that help a person keep or build independence, usually in their own home.
: Visits to people at home or in care settings, and visiting-based practical or emotional support, including home help visits.
: Receiving personal and domiciliary care in your own home, including live-in care and home health services.
